title: Good Times Bad Times
studio_context: Recorded at Olympic Studios, London, in October 1968; the opening track of the first album.

drum_performances.name: John Bonham
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His first statement on record: a cowbell intro, then fast triplets on a single bass drum pedal that drummers still argue about.

notable_moments.description: Two kicks after each hand stroke, in sextuplets, on one pedal.
